name: Provisur Technologies
old_description: Produce high quality applications that hit all the industry trends — cleanly and efficiently. Our portfolio of leading food processing machine brands and decades of food science and sales experience help your business win in growing food markets.
about:
Provisur Technologies is headquartered in Mokena, Illinois. The company operates as a global manufacturer of food processing equipment, drawing on decades of food science and sales experience. While a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed, the business has built a portfolio of established brands that serve protein processors worldwide.

The company designs and builds equipment for separation, grinding, forming, slicing, cooking, defrosting, and marinating. Key product lines include Weiler mixer grinders, Formax formers, Beehive separators, and Lutetia defrosting tumblers. Provisur runs two Ingenuity Centers where customers can test applications on full-scale machinery. A global staff of food processing professionals provides parts and service support. The company employs approximately 3,000 people.

Provisur serves the food processing industry, with a focus on meat, poultry, seafood, and prepared foods manufacturers. Its equipment produces items such as burgers, pork patties, chicken nuggets, patties and fries, meatballs, and fish sticks. Customers range from large-scale protein processors to companies developing new formed and sliced products.

Provisur emphasizes innovation, customization, and high performance to deliver quality control, throughput, flexibility, and hygiene. The company says its brand portfolio and application expertise help customers win in growing food markets.
